_comment: Cross-repo password-hash contract: bcrypt(password.toLowerCase(), 10). Every hash below must verify against `password` and against its lower-cased form, from either repo. bcrypt salts randomly, so the strings differ by design and only verification is meaningful. Add an entry (do not replace one) when the engine publishes a new fixture.

hashes.note: published by the engine task (Task A) as the canonical cross-repo fixture
produced by bcrypt.hashSync(password.toLowerCase(), 10), the call LoginServer.ts makes
